# GitStack Issue Templates

GitHub issues templates for public reports on the read-only mirror. Use these
to report bugs or request features on GitStack.

- **Bug report** (`bug.md`): report a bug.
- **Feature request** (`feature.md`): suggest a new feature.
- **Security issue** (`security.md`): for security vulnerabilities only.
  Security reports must be made **privately** via
  [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md).

GitHub is a **read-only mirror** of GitStack. Use the issue templates here
for public reports. For security vulnerabilities, see
[`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) for private reporting channels.
